works.author: Kris Anfalova
works.comment: 银行支付类移动端信息架构，卡片余额、转账入口与交易流排布紧凑，金融 App 首屏层级可借鉴。
works.comment_en: Banking/payment mobile IA: card balances, transfer entry, and transaction flow packed tightly — a first-screen hierarchy worth borrowing for finance apps.
works.title: Mobile App Design — Banking, Payment

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 牛排餐厅点餐 App，深色质感配大图菜品卡，餐饮类 App 的食欲感营造与下单路径值得学。
works.comment_en: Steakhouse ordering app: dark textures with big dish cards — worth studying for appetite appeal and the order path in food apps.
works.title: Steakhouse Mobile App UI

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 患者门户 App，预约、日程与健康记录同屏呈现，医疗类产品的三栏信息架构清晰。
works.comment_en: Patient-portal app: appointments, schedule, and health records on one screen — a clear three-column IA for healthcare products.
works.title: Health Care App - Patient Portal

works.author: Plainthing Studio
works.comment: 数据驱动的健康平台官网，指标可视化与动效叙事结合，SaaS 落地页讲数据故事可参考。
works.comment_en: Data-driven health platform site: metric visualization meets motion storytelling — a reference for data stories on SaaS landing pages.
works.title: Welling - Data Driven Health Platform Website Ainamation

works.author: strangehelix
works.comment: AI 远程医疗处方状态页，处方进度、医生备注与复诊入口编排清晰，AI+医疗的结果呈现范例。
works.comment_en: AI telehealth prescription-status page: prescription progress, doctor notes, and follow-up entry arranged clearly — a model result presentation for AI+healthcare.
works.title: osler v3: AI Telehealth & Telemedicine App - Prescription Status

works.author: Pixcut Studio UI/UX
works.comment: AI 自动化 SaaS 官网，深色渐变配产品截图轮播，AI 工具类站点的首屏信任感营造值得抄。
works.comment_en: AI automation SaaS site: dark gradients with a product-screenshot carousel — first-screen trust-building worth stealing for AI tool sites.
works.title: Aovix — Premium AI Automation & SaaS Website Design

works.author: HALO LAB
works.comment: 旅行公司产品页（视频），场景化大图配行程卡片，旅游类产品的沉浸式叙事可借鉴。
works.comment_en: Travel company product page (video): scenic big imagery with itinerary cards — immersive narrative worth borrowing for travel products.
works.title: Product for a Travel Company ✦ Afloat

works.author: Alamin Hossen
works.comment: 金融落地页 3D 动效，抽象几何配数字滚动，fintech 落地页的动感表达有参考价值。
works.comment_en: Fintech landing page in 3D motion: abstract geometry with rolling numbers — a valuable reference for dynamic expression on fintech pages.
works.title: Finance Landing page web design 3D animation

works.author: Awe Design Studio
works.comment: 招聘者 Web 应用（视频），候选人看板、筛选器与沟通记录同屏，招聘类后台的信息架构清晰。
works.comment_en: Recruiter web app (video): candidate board, filters, and communication log on one screen — clear IA for hiring back offices.
works.title: Web Application for Recruiter

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 理赔裁决 Web 应用，案件队列、规则引擎与审批流分区明确，复杂后台的任务流设计范例。
works.comment_en: Claims-adjudication web app: case queue, rules engine, and approval flow in clear zones — a task-flow model for complex back offices.
works.title: Claims Adjudication Software Web App Design
